landing.headline: No more lines at the barangay hall.
landing.opening: Opening your barangay… (the free server takes up to a minute to wake up)
landing.demoFailed: We couldn't open a demo barangay. Please try again.
landing.demoNote: You get your own demo barangay for 24 hours, with a kapitan, staff and a resident to try.
landing.annotation: Your number, live on your phone
landing.ctaTitle: See it work in a minute
landing.ctaBody: Open the counter, call a number, and watch it ring on the TV and on a resident's phone.
landing.footer: B.Queue · a portfolio project. Demo barangays and their data are deleted after 24 hours.

requests.title: Request documents online
requests.body: Residents ask for a clearance, residency or indigency certificate from their phone and follow each step until it is ready.

queue.title: A live queue
queue.body: Take a number from home or the kiosk, see how many are ahead, and get an alert when it is almost your turn.

tv.title: The TV calls your number
tv.body: The hall's TV shows who is being served and reads the number aloud in Filipino or English.

verify.title: QR verification
verify.body: Every released document carries a QR code. Anyone can scan it to check that it is real and still valid.

credits.title: Credits
credits.soundsBody: The TV chime and the phone alert are B.Queue's own, made from sine tones by tools/make-sounds.mjs.
